Theorem
[Uniform total boundedness criterion] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0417 1. appG:G.18\group Gromov compactness A family of compact metric spaces with uniformly bounded diameter and uniformly bounded cardinalities of $\epsilon $-nets is precompact in Gromov--Hausdorff distance.
